--- title: "Hands-on_Ex07a" author: "Huang Zhanyi" date: "June 4, 2026" date-modified: "last-modified" execute: eval: true echo: true warning: false freeze: true --- ## 27.1 Overview This exercise covers modelling, analysing, and visualising network data using R — including graph objects, network metrics, and interactive graphs. ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 27.2 Getting Started ### 27.2.1 Installing and Launching R Packages Install and load the required packages. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(igraph, tidygraph, ggraph, visNetwork, lubridate, clock, tidyverse, graphlayouts, concaveman, ggforce) ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 27.3 The Data Two datasets from an oil exploration company: - **Edges**: `GAStech-email_edges.csv` — 9,063 email records between 55 employees over 2 weeks - **Nodes**: `GAStech_email_nodes.csv` — names, departments, and titles of 55 employees ### 27.3.3 Importing Network Data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_nodes <- read_csv("/Users/zhanyi/Desktop/M Y1S2/ISSS608/ISSS608-VAA/project 1/ISSS608/Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex07a/data/GAStech_email_node.csv") GAStech_edges <- read_csv("/Users/zhanyi/Desktop/M Y1S2/ISSS608/ISSS608-VAA/project 1/ISSS608/Hands-on_Ex/Hands-on_Ex07a/data/edgev2.csv") ``` ::: ### 27.3.4 Reviewing the Imported Data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glimpse(GAStech_edges) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 9,063 Columns: 8 $ source 43, 43, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 44, 26, 26, 26… $ target 41, 40, 51, 52, 53, 45, 44, 46, 48, 49, 47, 54, 27, 28, 29… $ SentDate "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014", "6/1/2014"… $ SentTime 08:39:00, 08:39:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:00, 08:58:0… $ Subject "GT-SeismicProcessorPro Bug Report", "GT-SeismicProcessorP… $ MainSubject "Work related", "Work related", "Work related", "Work rela… $ sourceLabel "Sven.Flecha", "Sven.Flecha", "Kanon.Herrero", "Kanon.Herr… $ targetLabel "Isak.Baza", "Lucas.Alcazar", "Felix.Resumir", "Hideki.Coc… ``` ::: ::: ### 27.3.5 Wrangling Time Convert `SentDate` from character to Date and extract the weekday. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges <- GAStech_edges %>% mutate(SendDate = dmy(SentDate), Weekday = wday(SendDate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) ``` ::: ### 27.3.7 Wrangling Attributes Aggregate individual email records by sender, receiver, and weekday. A `Weight` column counts emails per group. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>% filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>% group_by(source, target, Weekday) %>% summarise(Weight = n()) %>% filter(source!=target) %>% filter(Weight > 1) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 27.4 Creating Network Objects Using tidygraph ### 27.4.3 Using tbl_graph() to Build the tidygraph Data Model ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = GAStech_nodes, edges = GAStech_edges_aggregated, directed = TRUE) ``` ::: ### 27.4.6 Changing the Active Object Switch to the edges tibble and reorder by descending weight. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_graph %>% activate(edges) %>% arrange(desc(Weight)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tbl_graph: 54 nodes and 1456 edges # # A directed multigraph with 1 component # # Edge Data: 1,456 × 4 (active) from to Weekday Weight 1 40 41 Tuesday 23 2 40 43 Tuesday 19 3 41 43 Tuesday 15 4 41 40 Tuesday 14 5 42 41 Tuesday 13 6 42 40 Tuesday 12 7 42 43 Tuesday 11 8 43 42 Wednesday 11 9 36 32 Wednesday 9 10 40 41 Monday 9 # ℹ 1,446 more rows # # Node Data: 54 × 4 id label Department Title 1 1 Mat.Bramar Administration Assistant to CEO 2 2 Anda.Ribera Administration Assistant to CFO 3 3 Rachel.Pantanal Administration Assistant to CIO # ℹ 51 more rows ``` ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 27.5 Plotting Static Network Graphs with ggraph ### 27.5.1 Plotting a Basic Network Graph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link() + geom_node_point() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.5.2 Changing the Default Network Graph Theme Removes axes, grids, and borders for a cleaner look. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes()) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.5.3 Changing the Colouring of the Plot ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes(colour = 'grey50')) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = 'grey40')) g + theme_graph(background = 'grey10', text_colour = 'white') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.5.5 Fruchterman and Reingold Layout ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes()) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.5.6 Modifying Network Nodes Colour nodes by department. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = 3)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.5.7 Modifying Edges Map edge width to `Weight` and add transparency. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 3) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 27.6 Creating Facet Graphs ### 27.6.1 Working with facet_edges() Split the graph into panels by `Weekday`. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_edges(~Weekday) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.6.2 Moving the Legend ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') g + facet_edges(~Weekday) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-15-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.6.3 A Framed Facet Graph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_edges(~Weekday) + th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-16-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.6.4 Working with facet_nodes() ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_nodes(~Department)+ th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-17-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 27.7 Network Metrics Analysis ### 27.7.1 Computing Centrality Indices Calculate betweenness centrality and map it to node size. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% mutate(betweenness_centrality = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size=betweenness_centrality)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-18-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.7.2 Visualising Network Metrics From ggraph v2.0, centrality measures can be computed directly inside the `ggraph` call without precomputing. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = centrality_betweenness())) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-19-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### 27.7.3 Visualising Community Detect communities using edge-betweenness and colour nodes by community. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% mutate(community = as.factor( group_edge_betweenness( weights = Weight, directed = TRUE))) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link( aes( width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width( range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point( aes(colour = community)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-20-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: Use `geom_mark_hull()` from `ggforce` to draw convex hulls around communities. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% activate(nodes) %>% mutate(community = as.factor( group_optimal(weights = Weight)), betweenness_measure = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_mark_hull( aes(x, y, group = community, fill = community), alpha = 0.2, expand = unit(0.3, "cm"), radius = unit(0.3, "cm") ) + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(fill = Department, size = betweenness_measure), color = "black", shape = 21) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07a_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-21-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 27.8 Building Interactive Network Graph with visNetwork ### 27.8.1 Data Preparation Re-aggregate edges using `left_join` to get proper `from`/`to` node IDs required by `visNetwork`. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("sourceLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(from = id) %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("targetLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(to = id) %>% filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>% group_by(from, to) %>% summarise(weight = n()) %>% filter(from!=to) %>% filter(weight > 1) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ### 27.8.2 Plotting the First Interactive Network Graph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 27.8.3 Working with Layout ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 27.8.4 Working with Visual Attributes — Nodes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 27.8.5 Working with Visual Attributes — Edges Add directional arrows and smooth curved edges. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = list(enabled = TRUE, type = "curvedCW")) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 27.8.6 Interactivity Highlight nearest neighbours on click and add a node selection dropdown. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: :::
